title: 1535. Find the Winner of an Array Game

examples.explanation: Let's see the rounds of the game: Round |       arr       | winner | win_count 1   | [2,1,3,5,4,6,7] | 2      | 1 2   | [2,3,5,4,6,7,1] | 3      | 1 3   | [3,5,4,6,7,1,2] | 5      | 1 4   | [5,4,6,7,1,2,3] | 5      | 2 So we can see that 4 rounds will be played and 5 is the winner because it wins 2 consecutive games.
3 will win the first 10 rounds consecutively.
